calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13)
SELECT (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM l) fact_units_all, (SELECT count(*)-count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM l) dup_receipt_line,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') rpt_units,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE sale_date<>CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) date_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE quantity<=0) nonpos

calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE st.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13)
SELECT (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM s) sold, (SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id) returned_of_these,
 (SELECT sum(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE st.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13) as_was_units
